title: Zip
description: Zips each archived app and each SwiftPM executable product's release build with ditto; an archive with a method is exported with it first, notarized with notarytool, stapled, and zipped again

folder.description: Folder holding the zip, and the export of a notarized archive

method.description: Export method, present where the archive configuration signs with a Developer ID Application identity and the hardened runtime

exports.description: Archives the plugin infers for the scheme's archive configuration, none in any other configuration

package.description: Package folder, passed as --package-path to swift build --show-bin-path

product.description: Executable product swift package describe names

manifest.description: Info.plist the product embeds, whose CFBundleShortVersionString names the zip

products.description: Executable products the plugin infers for the release configuration, none in any other configuration

profile.description: notarytool keychain profile from the plugin's notaryProfile option, required by archives with a method

args.description: Arguments after -- appended to notarytool submit, else to ditto
